articles.title: EasyA hits $1.1 billion valuation, targets 2027 public listing and tokenized shares
articles.snippet: The blockchain and AI developer platform has completed two years of audits and wants its shares available onchain from the first day of trading.

articles.title: Former FTX Europe chief targets U.S. tokenized stock trading with new SEC exemption
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed Perpetuals.com is the second company to pursue a U.S. tokenized stock marketplace under the SEC's new framework, following a joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent ICE.

articles.title: S&P 500 options are the hottest bet on this Hyperliquid exchange
articles.snippet: Hypercall, an exchange built on Hyperliquid, says most of its $640 million in volume since June has come from the index.

articles.title: Proposed 31.4% French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
articles.snippet: Chainalysis' regional sales director in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

articles.title: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
articles.snippet: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets.
